contract: Same public scalar APIs. Normalize identical original quote abort domains within existing slot via WeakMap, release on retirement. Cancellation of either same-domain active member terminates physical daemon and settles both; unrelated queued cancellations remain isolated. New work waits for last pair response. All scalar response/attestation validation unchanged.
lateResponses: Live response identities remain strictly ordered. Retired mode retains original policy: late successes for actually-issued IDs ignored; any matched fatal delivered, unknown IDs fail protocol. Pair IDs never assigned to a different request. This preserves existing buffered-expiry duplicate-success regression.
